items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: Now, Edmund played with us a couple of times, after Alvin left to go away with, uh, to play with Ory.

ctx.x: Well, he likes, he's a trumpet player, but he's crazy about the bass. And he brings his bass here sometimes, we have a session. I'm trying to get Father Al to come, you know, Father Alfred Lewis? Yeah. Well, that's another guy, see? He, if I could get him and Edmund together, and on the piano, we stayed here all day, because Edmund stayed here from about ten in the morning till six o'clock at the evening. He's run over different numbers, see? And, uh, he was listening at the changes that I was making, I was…
